name: Walkietoon
source:
Hidden in the depths of the Canadian Rockies lies a quaint little town... a place seemingly perfect from the outside, but what secrets lie beneath its picturesque visage? Follow the journey of Brody Fuller in his search for his missing friend. Enlist the help of the seductive chef, the charming groundskeeper, or the chiseled police officer as he unravels the mysteries of Walkietoon. Will you be able to see through the web of lies before it's not t̸̢̉͗͛͛̓͂̓ò̵̖͓̯̠̒̀̈́̐̀́ö̶̼̫̠͚̣̘͊̀ͅ ̴̧̗̼̦͑̓l̵͍͇̺͈̮̤̄̈́̃͆̉͝ͅą̸̺͍̩́͐̇̑̕͝t̷̥͈̬̃̾̈́̀͊͘ȅ̷̛̻͎̾̽̋̈́?

[From [url=https://heypau.itch.io/walkietoon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
隐藏在加拿大落基山脉深处的一座古色古香的小镇……从外表看来，这个地方似乎很完美，但在其风景如画的面貌下隐藏着什么秘密呢？跟随布罗迪·富勒寻找失踪朋友的旅程。在迷人的厨师、迷人的场地管理员或轮廓分明的警察的帮助下，他将揭开Walkietoon的神秘面纱。你能否在谎言未成之前看穿它̸̢̉͗͛͛̓͂̓ò̵̖͓̯̠̒̀̈́̐̀́ö̶̼̫̠͚̣̘͊̀ͅ ̴̧̗̼̦͑̓l̵͍͇̺͈̮̤̄̈́̃͆̉͝ͅą̸̺͍̩́͐̇̑̕͝t̷̥͈̬̃̾̈́̀͊͘ş̷̛̻͎̾̽̋̈́？
